title: upgrade-attn-flashattnv2-rope-rotary-fused-kv-batching-scheduling
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce per-token latency and improve sustained throughput for long-context workloads by upgrading attention kernels to FlashAttentionV2 variants and fusing rotary/RoPE operations where possible, plus scheduler tweaks to improve continuous batching and KV cache coalescing. Summary of changes: 1) Integrate FlashAttentionV2 fused path for rotary and RoPE variants (runtime/attn/flashattn_v2.cu, runtime/attn/kernel_dispatch.cpp). 2) Add a fused-op option that merges rotary/rope + qkv transpose + dropout passthrough into a single CUDA kernel for common model configs to reduce kernel launch overhead. 3) KV-cache coalescing: batch small KV appends into single device writes to reduce PCIe stalls (runtime/cache/kv_coalesce.cc). 4) Continuous batching scheduler improvements: new low-latency flush policy and adaptive batch size cap to lower tail latency under bursty traffic (runtime/scheduler/continuous_batcher.cpp). 5) New microbench harness and long-sequence benchmarks (benchmarks/attn/long_context_bench.py) and end-to-end perf regression tests. Performance: on internal Llama-2-13B-like profile with 8k context, median per-token latency decreased ~22% (from 12.8ms -> 10.0ms) and throughput for sustained generation improved ~1.8x under multi-request steady-state with KV batching enabled. Tail p95 latency improved ~18% under bursty arrivals with the updated continuous batcher. Compatibility and fallback: the new fused kernels are enabled behind a runtime flag (ATTN_FUSED_OPS=true) and runtime will automatically fallback to older kernels when shapes/quantization profiles are unsupported. Rollout plan: feature gated, staged rollout to Canary and then Dedicated pools over 3 days, monitor latency/throughput dashboards and quality evals. Testing: unit tests for kernel dispatch and cache coalescing, CUDA smoke tests, benchmark comparisons added. Impact/risk: medium — kernel changes are isolated but require careful GPU regression testing; fallback paths exist. Related: ENG-4823 (attn perf spike investigation), ENG-4950 (kv batching research). Checklist: [x] Unit tests added [x] Benchmarks added [x] Performance numbers validated in benchmark lab [x] Rollout plan included [x] Docs/flags updated
commits_summary: 3 commits: (1) core: add FlashAttentionV2 fused rotary/rope kernels + kernel selection logic; (2) perf: KV cache coalescing and device write batching; (3) scheduler: continuous batcher adaptive flush policy + tests and benchmarks.

Aisha Patel: Responded that added explicit dtype checks in kernel_dispatch.cpp and extended unit tests to cover the cases. Pushed a follow-up commit that adds the asserts behind a debug build flag.
